title: Q2 两级调度：卡车跨区 + 三轮车区内
summary: R1 fixes the three defects in R0. (1) Tricycle distance is now split into bicycle-km and vehicle-km: the cost curve, the DP and the comparison price vehicle-km at 0.20 CNY, the same unit the LP objective uses. (2) The sample schedule now carries whole bicycles: each LP arc flow is rounded to an integer under the donor's integer stock, loads are at most 20, and per-tricycle daily totals are integers. (3) The per-zone upper bound is raised from 20 to 40 tricycles. The corrected optimum is 885 tricycles (50 zones, median 18.5, max 40, one zone at the cap), moving 152,269 bicycles and 4,137 vehicle-km at 266,327 CNY/day (265,500 fixed + 827 mileage). Cell-level unmet falls from 239,245 to 40,357 (1.89%); total cost 592,279 vs 1,519,279 truck-only, a saving of 927,000 CNY/day (61.0%) at the 6 CNY service penalty. The layer breaks even at 1.339 CNY per removed unmet trip at this fleet, at 0.4311 CNY globally (the minimum over fleet sizes, attained at N=100), and at a fixed cost of 1,347 CNY per tricycle-day. Sensitivity in the per-zone cap: at 20 the optimum is 741 tricycles (50,508 unmet, 609,912 total, 17 zones at the cap), at 30 it is 865 (41,841 unmet, 595,169), at 40 it is 885 (40,357 unmet, 592,279, 1 zone at the cap). The sample schedule for zone 24 (40 allocated + 4 buffer tricycles) has 395 integer-load trips, zero unassigned, maximum load 20 and last completion 19.29 h; rounding costs 26.5 of 6,193 bicycles (0.43%) in that zone, and the citywide extrapolated bound is about 2.5% of the 198,888 removed trips.

The LP objective charges TRI_KM*d/Q per bicycle (vehicle-km), so the DP cost now uses tricycle_vehicle_km: tricycle_cost = 300*885 + 0.20*4,136.978 = 266,327.40. bike_km (sum of d*f) is reported separately: 82,739.55 = 20 x 4,136.98. The old 233,410 cost used bike-km at 0.20 CNY, a factor Q too high; the R0 evidence ratio 2,017.07/221.69 = 9.10 was the average load, as the reviewer identified. New fields: tricycle_vehicle_km, tricycle_bike_km, curves.km (vehicle), curves.bike_km (bicycle).

The reviewer's 0.4893 used the old 34,296.1 cost at N=100; the difference is exactly the mileage correction. The 1.339 figure is the fleet-885 marginal threshold, not the global one.

notes: Mileage unit: the LP objective was always vehicle-km (TRI_KM*d/Q per bicycle); only the cost curve and comparison had used bicycle-km. The fix leaves the LP solution unchanged and prices the layer correctly.

Per-zone cap: at NMAX=40 the optimum is 885 and one zone (24) is at the cap; at 30 it is 865 and four zones are at the cap. The residual 40,357 is not a boundary artifact: adding the last 20 tricycles (30->40) still removes 1,484 unmet trips. The R0 claim that saturation was due to marginal cost below 300 CNY was circular; it is withdrawn.

The sample schedule covers one zone (the one with the largest allocation, zone 24). Rounding each LP arc flow to whole bicycles costs 26.5 of 6,192 bicycles (0.43%) in that zone; the citywide extrapolated bound (0.5 per trip) is about 2.5% of the 198,888 removed trips. The schedule check reports every per-tricycle day total as an integer.

The two tiers are sequential: T018's integer truck plan is fixed and the tricycle layer clears its residual. A joint model could re-optimise trucks knowing the tricycles exist; that would lower the truck cost and strengthen the two-tier conclusion.

pre_tricycle_shortfall in compare.json is measured along the with-tricycle stock path: earlier-hour prepositioning already lowers it, so it is not the no-tricycle counterfactual (no_tricycle.cell_unmet=239,245.2). The headline reduction is 198,887.9.

Cell-level interval: the static hourly arrival-surface split is a lower bound (bikes are re-split for free every hour); the dynamic no-tricycle replay is the operational upper bound. Walking across cell boundaries is not modelled at 300 m because no neighbouring centre is within reach (centres 426 m x 556 m apart).

Tricycle parameters remain planning assumptions (web lookup unavailable); the delivery reports the break-evens that make the conclusion robust: 1.339 CNY per removed trip at the chosen fleet, 0.4311 CNY globally, and 1,347 CNY per tricycle-day.

The comparison holds the T018 truck plan fixed in every row; the truck objective 83,807.74 includes the fixed 36,000 CNY for 60 trucks. The two-tier saving is computed against the same truck plan plus the 6 CNY cell-level penalty, so the 61.0% is a like-for-like system saving, not a budget that can be added to Q3.
